title: DocumentReleaseSearchSegment
description: One deterministic, bounded search segment. Carries its structural parent, its order, its heading path, its representation range, and reversible coordinates into the exact captured bytes. These segments are a TWO-consumer contract: SpicySearch and the Rulespec Extrapolator both consume them, and neither may run a second segmentation pipeline.

textBodyId.description: The text body this row belongs to. Re-keyed from `documentVersionId`: structure and segments are the same records for a document body, an attachment, and a comment. For a `document-body` the value EQUALS its `documentVersionId` — one body per version, and a second name would be a second identity for one thing.

textKind.description: Which kind of text body this row belongs to. Exactly TEXT_SOURCE_KINDS minus `metadata-field`: one text pipeline, three kinds.

structuralParentId.description: The structural node this segment came from. Never null: a segment with no source structure has no coordinates to be reversible against.

ordinal.description: Position within the document. Dense and zero-based across the whole document, so segment order is total and reconstructible.

headingPath.description: Heading text from the text body's root down to this segment's structural parent, outermost first. Empty when no ancestor carries a heading.

representationStart.description: Half-open [start, end) over the selected representation's UTF-8 bytes. Must lie inside the structural parent's range.

evidenceCoordinate.description: Reversible coordinates into the exact captured rendition. The rendition is named by digest rather than by path, so evidence survives any relocation of the member.

coordinateSystem.description: CLOSED at exactly two systems: `rendition-utf8-byte` when the captured bytes are themselves UTF-8 text, `rendition-byte` for any other captured encoding or binary container. A third `rendition-page-region` system was designed and dropped — no extractor DocSpec runs emits page geometry, so the release would carry a coordinate nothing can produce or check.

evidenceGrade.description: RESERVED for a later evidence grading and unpopulated in 2.0: the name is claimed beside the closed `coordinateSystem` enum so grading can land without re-keying the coordinate. A 2.0 producer writes null or omits it; nothing reads it.
